mechanism: Dexamethasone increases bone resorption and may potentiate bisphosphonate effects while increasing risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw; both agents can impair renal function and cause hypocalcemia.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and renal function regularly; ensure adequate vitamin D and calcium supplementation; assess dental health before zoledronic acid initiation; consider alternative corticosteroid or bisphosphonate if prolonged high-dose dexamethasone required.
